questions.stem: An item marked 800 is sold at a 25% discount. What is the selling price?
questions.explain: A 25% discount leaves 75% of the marked price: 0.75 × 800 = 600.

questions.stem: Divide 90 in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. What is the largest share?
questions.explain: There are 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 parts, so one part is 9. The largest share is 5 × 9 = 45.
